text:
oliver: Follow-up from the postmortem (PM-2026-078) on the cross-region retry storm. Root causes: control-plane applying stale route fragments during canary roll, DNS negative-caching prolonging old answers, and TLS handshake churn amplifying client retries. Dropping owners, short verification steps, and ETAs here so we can track in one place.

ops-bot: Postmortem recorded: PM-2026-078 https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PM-2026-078 :bookmark_tabs: 

rachel: I'll own the control-plane change. Plan: implement a per-route apply checksum and skip if checksum matches (fast-path), plus a short cooldown after 3 rapid applies. Mitigation ETA: 2026-06-28 16:00 UTC.

diego: I'll take DNS. Action: add targeted invalidation event on flips, shorten canary TTL to 5s for the flip window, and emit dns_negative_cache_hits metric. ETA: 2026-06-28 18:30 UTC.

kai: TLS owner here. Observed SNI mismatch under bursty rotation. I'll add randomized rotation offsets, lower concurrency of fresh handshakes per edge, and a small exponential backoff on handshake retry attempts. ETA: 2026-06-29 11:00 UTC.

anika: I'll own monitoring + runbook. Adding composite alert rules and a short triage checklist. Alert: (route_apply_retries > 4 in 5m) OR (dns_negative_cache_hits > 10 in 10m) OR (edge_handshake_retry_rate > 1% in 5m) => page networking-oncall. ETA: 2026-06-28 20:00 UTC.

oliver: Action list (confirm please):
- ACTION rachel: per-route checksum + cooldown guard  ETA 2026-06-28 16:00 UTC
- ACTION diego: invalidation event + TTL shrink + metric  ETA 2026-06-28 18:30 UTC
- ACTION kai: rotation offsets + handshake concurrency cap + backoff  ETA 2026-06-29 11:00 UTC
- ACTION anika: composite alerts + runbook snippet  ETA 2026-06-28 20:00 UTC

rachel: quick note  cooldown will be non-blocking and scoped to route-id, default 60s. We'll expose flag to pause cooldown if needed for emergency rollouts.

diego: invalidation events will be idempotent and include a flip_correlation_id so we can trace across services.

kai: adding handshake histogram by region so we can correlate latency -> retry amplification.

anika: runbook snippet (excerpt):
"If composite alert fires: 1) attach latest probe CSV, 2) check dns_negative_cache_hits, 3) if route_apply_retries > threshold -> consider pausing canary flips, 4) if edge_handshake_retry_rate high -> throttle new handshakes and roll back rotation window."

ops-bot: Follow-up check-in scheduled: 2026-06-29 09:00 UTC.

rachel: Update 2026-06-28 15:40 UTC: checksum logic merged to canary branch, deploying to canary pool now.

diego: Update 2026-06-28 18:05 UTC: TTL change + invalidation event pushed to canary; dns_negative_cache_hits dropped ~88% in early telemetry.

kai: Update 2026-06-29 10:30 UTC: rotation offsets and handshake caps rolled to region-d; early telemetry shows edge_handshake_retry_rate down ~72%. Scheduling global edge rollout at 2026-06-29 14:00 UTC.

anika: Update 2026-06-29 12:00 UTC: composite alert rules created and smoke-tested. Runbook added to PM-2026-078.

oliver: Verification plan: kai and rachel please run the probe matrix after your canary rollouts across three regions and post CSV here. Probe command we usually use:
```
curl -sS -H "Host: api.redwood.internal" https://lb-probe.local/check -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```

rachel: Update 2026-06-28 17:20 UTC: canary deployment finished; probe sweep starting now.

kai: Update 2026-06-29 15:10 UTC: full edge rollout complete; global telemetry looks stable and p95 latencies are normal.

diego: Update 2026-06-29 16:00 UTC: probe CSV uploaded to PM-2026-078, no asymmetric 5xx spikes observed.

anika: Final: runbook validated, alerts in play, and immediate follow-ups closed. Moving longer-term items (conntrack tuning, client retry heuristics, reconciler resilience refactor) to grooming backlog. Reopen here if regression. :white_check_mark:
